column1: • Growth in market for value-added products which have better margins

• ABC (Aerial Bundled Conductors) sales in Kenya, Uganda, Tanzania &
Rwanda – Conductors used for power distribution ideal for cities and
towns with high density.

• Concentric cable sales in Kenya – Power distribution conductors used for
last mile connections.

• On-going programs by utilities to rehabilitate existing grids, increase new
connections and enhance power generation; replacing overhead lines
with over head insulated cables - ABC.

• Copper cables demand driven by the increased private sector building
with a recorded growth in the construction industry of 9.2 per cent in
2016 (2017 Kenya Economic Survey) due to increased housing and office
space demand.

• Improvement in enforcement of regulations on the local content bill
(Energy regulations, 2014) in Kenya gazetted in 2014 which includes
legislation that 30-90% of Cables and conductors be sourced locally.

• New transmission lines to cater for new power plants, regional
interconnection between countries and increase in demand patterns
requiring higher capacity lines.
